summary: Many Notes is a web-based note-taking application built around Markdown formatting. It provides a straightforward digital workspace for writing and organising plain text notes in a browser. The project is distributed under the MIT licence and managed via Docker containers.
goodFor: This is a suitable option if you want a lightweight, self-hosted Markdown scratchpad without the complexity of larger knowledge management suites.
watchOut: The repository has a modest community size and competes in a crowded ecosystem of well-established note-taking tools, meaning you might encounter missing features or fewer third-party integrations.
deployNotes: As a containerised web application, you will typically need to map a persistent volume for your notes storage and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
